notes.title: Input System Revolution !
notes.content:
Thanks to the users who reached out to us with feedback about RC Plane 3 input system we where able to realise that joystick support was terrible, with many input devices not supported or not correctly configurable. 

We have taken extensive action and we are very happy to announce that a completely new input system is currently available to test in the public beta branch of RC Plane 3 (together with other minor bug fixes) and will soon be released for all with an update. New system should allow to utilise and correctly configure practically every joystick with many automatically recognised and configured.*

To join the beta, right click on RC Plane 3 in your Steam library, click "Properties", reach the "Beta" tab and select "test - Public Beta Branch" from the dropdown menu, beta version should immediately start downloading as a normal update.


Great thanks to all users who have been helping us improving RC Plane 3 !
We greatly appreciate your feedback, so keep it coming ! 


*WARNING: previous joystick and control mappings will be lost, but new system is way more effective.
